about_the_game:
About The Developer

I'm a solo developer creating a game I'm passionate about playing. I was inspired by Mario Golf Toadstool Tour, Marble Blast Ultra and various other challenge/puzzle games! As the community grows, I want to work together to ensure the final release exceeds expectations. As the community grows, I want to work together to ensure the final release exceeds expectations.

Full Release

I am currently on schedule to release the full version of the game Q4 2025. This will include many courses with new types of challenges and mechanics. You can join the discord to follow the development of the game and give feedback on what you would like to see as the full finished product.

As the development of the game continues, I will update the store page with new screenshots and videos to showcase the progress being made. 

Gameplay Overview

  • Master 9 different shot types including Backspin, Topspin, Fades and Draws.

  • Face unique challenge modifiers like limited club uses, disabled clubs, or special course conditions.

  • Use your skills in Putting and Chipping to complete 3 challenges on each hole.

  • Earn Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum Stars based on your performance for each challenge.

  • Compete for the lowest scores on global Leaderboards.

Shot Shaping

Master the art of Shot Shaping to tackle any challenge:

  • Topspin - Bounce and Roll farther for maximum distance.

  • Backspin - Stops quickly with precise control on landing

  • Fade or Draw - Curve around obstacles to set up the perfect putt.

  • Shot Combinations - Combine spins for advanced techniques and creative solutions.

Challenges

  • Challenge Variety - Each hole transforms with different objectives, layouts, and rule modifications.

  • Course Alterations - Challenges can add/remove obstacles, change pin positions, or modify terrain.

  • Tactical Constraints - Face limitations like restricted clubs, shot limits, or special terrain types.
